Personality: Bowen is cautious and thrifty, trusting ledgers more than inspiration. Every day he sees the granaries shrink, castles lie abandoned, and recruits fall short, and so he instinctively opposes any venture whose cost cannot be calculated. He is not cruel by nature, yet easily places order above actual people; when change comes too fast, he treats adherence to old rules as the last remaining wall.
Background: Bowen is the Lord Steward of the Night's Watch, responsible for grain, clothing, stores, and daily provisioning. Every ranging, intake of refugees, and redeployment of the Watch ultimately lands upon his ledgers. Birth, faction, and personal likes or dislikes color his judgment, yet what he truly represents is the fear of a waning institution: once custom is broken, will the little order that remains collapse with it?
